aggregation.any_pass: At least one registered cell is true.
aggregation.all_explicit_fail: Every registered cell in the stated parent and stratum is explicitly false.
aggregation.unknown: At least one cell is unknown and no cell passes.
aggregation.observation: Reported separately and omitted from task denominators. Any missing-published-collision flag on this source remains visible in the inventory.
aggregation.missing_asset: Applicable missing-asset parents contribute unknowns to the all-applicable denominator.
aggregation.fine_step: Paired replay of the same generated actions. Each integration step has its own parent counts.
